round3_dispositions.evidence: The key group and the Disconnect row now sit under a "Wispr Flow" group header (step-key.png, step-connected.png), per TX-16. The pushed-detail alternative was not adopted; decided.
"Transcribing" and "Connected" both render rgb(79,179,127) on the phone (measured), matching web (TX-18).
The reading of the phone checkmark is decided (RX-59).
Disconnect is a red row that acts at once; decided (FX-63).

new_findings.description: In the Wispr Flow, key and Key rejected states the consent sentence (the footer under Connect) is below the bottom edge of the frame; the user has to scroll to read it. The mockup has no Typing state for this screen (Granola's phone frame got one in TX-13), so with the keyboard open the footer and possibly Connect would be hidden.
new_findings.expected: The consent footer is visible without scrolling, or a Typing state shows the list scrolled so the field, Connect and footer stay above the keyboard.
new_findings.actual: Footer clipped by the home indicator (step-key.png).
new_findings.suggested_fix: Add a Typing state as on the Granola phone frame, or scroll the frame so the key group is in view.
